reserveReview.rationale: Nest's live Available Vaults page reports server data loaded 2026-08-11, lists nTBILL's T+1 redemption estimate and current constituent categories (liquid assets, Janus Henderson Fund, and Superstate USTB), and renders mutable live weights that are intentionally not pinned here. Constituent-level look-through is admitted at limited quality only: Anemoy's JTRSY disclosure documents daily redemptions, a maximum six-month Treasury-bill maturity, and near-real-time holdings, while Superstate's USTB page documents short-duration Treasury Bills, market-day liquidity, and dated holdings as of 2026-07-24. Nest publishes no vault-level WAM, duration, or maturity aggregate, so no synthesized WAM/duration is recorded. On 2026-10-07 the exact Treasury Vault positions API identifies the USDC, USDT/USDT0 and pUSD rows as liquidAssets, with no nonzero pending transaction amounts. Keyed zero-percent metadata rows describe only these captured idle token categories; they do not assert zero live balances or refresh the historical aggregate composition. Immediate means availability of the idle native tokens, corroborated by the issuer's Instant Redemption description of available on-chain liquidity; it does not claim bank USD settlement, whole-vault withdrawal, bridge unwind, stressed realization or underlying fund redemption.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Nest live nTBILL vault disclosure and constituent fund disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The live page identifies the portfolio categories and named fund positions, but no durable allocation weights, stablecoin-buffer composition, custody-provider shares, vault-level WAM/duration, or maturity aggregate are retained in the reviewed sources.
